queries:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT ID, Date, CAST(HGB AS REAL) / HCT AS ratio
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_all FROM r
),
above AS (
  SELECT r.ID, r.Date, r.ratio, r.ratio - o.avg_all AS diff_overall
  FROM r, overall o
  WHERE r.ratio > o.avg_all
),
grp AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_grp FROM above
),
final AS (
  SELECT a.ratio, a.diff_overall, a.ratio - g.avg_grp AS diff_group
  FROM above a, grp g
  WHERE a.ratio > g.avg_grp
)
SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(diff_overall) AS avg_diff_overall,
       AVG(diff_group) AS avg_diff_group
FROM final;
WITH p AS (
  SELECT ID, AVG(HGB / HCT) AS r
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0
  GROUP BY ID
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(r) AS a FROM p
),
g1 AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.r, p.r - overall.a AS d1
  FROM p, overall
  WHERE p.r > overall.a
),
g1avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(r) AS b FROM g1
),
g2 AS (
  SELECT g1.ID, g1.r, g1.d1, g1.r - g1avg.b AS d2
  FROM g1, g1avg
  WHERE g1.r > g1avg.b
)
SELECT AVG(r) AS avg_ratio, AVG(d1) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(d2) AS avg_above_group
FROM g2
WITH p AS (
  SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) * 1.0 / NULLIF(AVG(HCT), 0) AS ratio
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
),
p2 AS (
  SELECT ID, ratio FROM p WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_all FROM p2
),
g1 AS (
  SELECT p2.ID, p2.ratio, p2.ratio - overall.avg_all AS above_overall
  FROM p2, overall
  WHERE p2.ratio > overall.avg_all
),
grp AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_grp FROM g1
),
g2 AS (
  SELECT g1.ID, g1.ratio, g1.above_overall, g1.ratio - grp.avg_grp AS above_group
  FROM g1, grp
  WHERE g1.ratio > grp.avg_grp
)
SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(above_overall) AS avg_above_overall,
       AVG(above_group) AS avg_above_group
FROM g2;
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT L.ID, L.HGB * 1.0 / L.HCT AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory L
    WHERE L.Date = (SELECT MAX(L2.Date) FROM Laboratory L2 WHERE L2.ID = L.ID)
      AND L.HGB IS NOT NULL AND L.HCT IS NOT NULL AND L.HCT <> 0
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_all FROM latest
),
above_all AS (
    SELECT l.ID, l.ratio, l.ratio - o.avg_all AS diff_overall
    FROM latest l, overall o
    WHERE l.ratio > o.avg_all
),
grp AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_grp FROM above_all
),
final AS (
    SELECT a.ID, a.ratio, a.diff_overall, a.ratio - g.avg_grp AS diff_group
    FROM above_all a, grp g
    WHERE a.ratio > g.avg_grp
)
SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(diff_overall) AS avg_diff_overall,
       AVG(diff_group) AS avg_diff_group
FROM final;
